items.title: Lionel Reason Interview, 1981-05-26
items.q: We had another boy named Cormick Scott. We got him out of Texas.

ctx.x: We had another boy named Cormick Scott. We got him out of Texas.
And you mentioned him with the Nighthawks, too. Cormick Scott. Was he with the Nighthawks? No. No, he wasn't with the Nighthawks. I got it. No.
